title: stormtrack: Tropical-cyclone best tracks and forecasts in Python (IMD, IBTrACS, NHC/JTWC)
description: A Python library that serves tropical-cyclone best tracks (the India Meteorological Department RSMC New Delhi record and IBTrACS) and real-time NHC/JTWC forecasts as tidy pandas DataFrames and CF-style xarray Datasets, with analysis, comparison and forecast-verification tools. The parsed datasets are kept up to date automatically.
notes: Formerly published as 'imdtrack'; the project was renamed 'stormtrack' and moved to the atmospy GitHub organisation (https://github.com/atmospy/stormtrack). All versions share one concept DOI.
